textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 116: Mercy toward Animals and Nature
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: In what way does excellence in mercy toward animals and nature and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 116: Mercy toward Animals and Nature
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: How can one safeguard mercy toward animals and nature and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 116: Mercy toward Animals and Nature
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to mercy toward animals and nature and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 116: Mercy toward Animals and Nature
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: Why is genuine devotion in mercy toward animals and nature and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 116: Mercy toward Animals and Nature
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: What spiritual wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ teach regarding modesty in dress and decorum?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: How does consistent practice of modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: What spiritual remedy does modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: Why is sincere commitment to modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: How did the noble Companions embody modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: In what way does excellence in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: How can one safeguard modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.

textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: In times of difficulty, how does modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: How does understanding modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: How does consistent practice of modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What spiritual remedy does modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: Why is sincere commitment to modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: How did the noble Companions embody modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: In what way does excellence in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: How can one safeguard modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: Why is genuine devotion in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ

question: How does moral beauty manifest through modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: In times of difficulty, how does modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How does understanding modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: How does consistent practice of modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: What spiritual remedy does modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: Why is sincere commitment to modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: How did the noble Companions embody modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: In what way does excellence in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: How can one safeguard modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: Why is genuine devotion in modesty in dress and decorum and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 117: Modesty in Dress and Decorum
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What spiritual wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ teach regarding spreading greetings of peace (salam)?

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: In times of difficulty, how does spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: How does understanding spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: How does consistent practice of spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: What spiritual remedy does spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: Why is sincere commitment to spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: How did the noble Companions embody spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: In what way does excellence in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: How can one safeguard spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: Why is genuine devotion in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: In times of difficulty, how does spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How does understanding spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: How does consistent practice of spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: What spiritual remedy does spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: Why is sincere commitment to spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: How did the noble Companions embody spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: In what way does excellence in spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: How can one safeguard spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to spreading greetings of peace (salam) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 118: Spreading Greetings of Peace (Salam)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: In times of difficulty, how does helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: How does understanding helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: How does consistent practice of helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: What spiritual remedy does helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: Why is sincere commitment to helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: How did the noble Companions embody helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: In what way does excellence in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: How can one safeguard helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: Why is genuine devotion in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.

keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: In what way does excellence in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: How can one safeguard helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: Why is genuine devotion in helping the stranded and traveler and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ

reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 119: Helping the Stranded and Traveler
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: What spiritual wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ teach regarding avoiding envy and malice (hasad)?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding avoiding envy and malice (hasad) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: How does consistent practice of avoiding envy and malice (hasad) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: What spiritual remedy does avoiding envy and malice (hasad) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: Why is sincere commitment to avoiding envy and malice (hasad) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: How did the noble Companions embody avoiding envy and malice (hasad) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 120: Avoiding Envy and Malice (Hasad)
