textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.

textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: In times of difficulty, how does contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: How does understanding contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How does consistent practice of contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What spiritual remedy does contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: Why is sincere commitment to contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: How did the noble Companions embody contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: In what way does excellence in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: How can one safeguard contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: Why is genuine devotion in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 141: Contentment with Moderate Earnings (Qana’ah)

question: How does the heart find tranquility through contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

question: How does moral beauty manifest through contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in contentment with moderate earnings (qana’ah) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How does consistent practice of ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What spiritual remedy does ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: Why is sincere commitment to ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: How did the noble Companions embody ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: In what way does excellence in ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: How can one safeguard ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: Why is genuine devotion in ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ

reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: How does understanding ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: How does consistent practice of ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: What spiritual remedy does ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: Why is sincere commitment to ethical inheritance distribution (mirath) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 142: Ethical Inheritance Distribution (Mirath)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: What spiritual remedy does returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely

question: Why is sincere commitment to returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: How did the noble Companions embody returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ

textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How can one safeguard returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: Why is genuine devotion in returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: In times of difficulty, how does returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: How does understanding returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: How does consistent practice of returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: What spiritual remedy does returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: Why is sincere commitment to returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: How did the noble Companions embody returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: In what way does excellence in returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: How can one safeguard returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: Why is genuine devotion in returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through returning borrowed articles safely and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 143: Returning Borrowed Articles Safely
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What spiritual wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ teach regarding avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ

keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: How does consistent practice of avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: In times of difficulty, how does avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: How does understanding avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: How does consistent practice of avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: How did the noble Companions embody avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: In what way does excellence in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: How can one safeguard avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: Why is genuine devotion in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: In times of difficulty, how does avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: How does understanding avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: How does consistent practice of avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: What spiritual remedy does avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: Why is sincere commitment to avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: How did the noble Companions embody avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: In what way does excellence in avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: How can one safeguard avoiding wasteful luxury in consumption and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 144: Avoiding Wasteful Luxury in Consumption
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.
