keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: In what way does excellence in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How can one safeguard purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: Why is genuine devotion in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: In times of difficulty, how does purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: How does understanding purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: How does consistent practice of purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: What spiritual remedy does purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: Why is sincere commitment to purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: How did the noble Companions embody purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: In what way does excellence in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: How can one safeguard purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: Why is genuine devotion in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ

reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: Why is sincere commitment to purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: How did the noble Companions embody purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: In what way does excellence in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: How can one safeguard purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: Why is genuine devotion in purifying the spiritual heart (qalb saleem) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 173: Purifying the Spiritual Heart (Qalb Saleem)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What spiritual wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ teach regarding the sickness of showing off (riya’)?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: How does consistent practice of the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: What spiritual remedy does the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: Why is sincere commitment to the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: How did the noble Companions embody the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ

textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ

reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ

reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: In times of difficulty, how does the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: How does understanding the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

question: How does consistent practice of the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

question: What spiritual remedy does the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

question: Why is sincere commitment to the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

question: How did the noble Companions embody the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

question: In what way does excellence in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

question: How can one safeguard the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

question: Why is genuine devotion in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

question: How does the heart find tranquility through the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

question: How can parents and mentors inspire the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

question: In times of difficulty, how does the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

question: How does understanding the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

question: How does consistent practice of the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

question: What spiritual remedy does the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

question: Why is sincere commitment to the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

question: How did the noble Companions embody the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

question: In what way does excellence in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

question: How can one safeguard the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

question: What essential principle transforms our approach to the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

question: Why is genuine devotion in the sickness of showing off (riya’) and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 174: The Sickness of Showing Off (Riya’)
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

question: How does moral beauty manifest through crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924, Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Compassion to all living beings is the golden key that unlocks divine mercy and forgiveness.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How can parents and mentors inspire crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
textEnglish: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Genuine faith cleanses the soul of jealousy and cultivates sincere goodwill toward all people.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
textEnglish: Indeed, the best and most beloved among you are those who possess the best character and manners.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Gentleness, integrity, and warmth of character are the true reflection of a living faith.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
textEnglish: Purity is half of faith, and “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah) fills the divine scale of deeds.
reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: In times of difficulty, how does crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
textEnglish: The first matter for which the slave of Allah will be brought to account on the Day of Judgment is his prayer.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 413, Sunan an-Nasa’i 465 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Salah is your personal appointment with the Lord of the worlds; safeguard its punctuality and focus.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ
textEnglish: Indeed, the religion is easy, and no one makes the religion overly difficult except that it will overcome him.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 39 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Adopt a steady, balanced pace of devotion; moderation sustains lifelong spiritual growth.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does understanding crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textEnglish: Richness is not about abundance of worldly possessions; true wealth is the richness of contentment in the soul.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446, Sahih Muslim 1051 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Peace is never found in endless material craving, but in tranquility and satisfaction with what Allah gave.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
textEnglish: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak what is beneficial or remain silent.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018, Sahih Muslim 47 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Guarding speech protects relationships and preserves the dignity and purity of the heart.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does consistent practice of crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
textEnglish: The example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407, Sahih Muslim 779 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Dhikr is the oxygen of the spiritual heart; without it, the inner being withers.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What spiritual remedy does crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
textEnglish: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, hurt, or distress befalls a believer—even the prick of a thorn—except that Allah expiates some of his sins through it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5641, Sahih Muslim 2573 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Every silent patience during hardship is recognized, rewarded, and purified by the Most Merciful.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: Why is sincere commitment to crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
textEnglish: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Radiating warmth and gentle kindness costs nothing yet carries eternal divine reward.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How did the noble Companions embody crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
textEnglish: The true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands other people are completely safe.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 10, Sahih Muslim 40 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Righteousness is verified when those around you live in safety from your harm and speech.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What warning or glad tiding is conveyed concerning crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
textEnglish: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5027 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Connecting yourself with the Book of Allah and sharing its light with others is the pinnacle of nobility.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: In what way does excellence in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: Whoever travels a path seeking sacred knowledge, Allah makes smooth for him a path to Paradise.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Every moment dedicated to understanding faith and truth brings you closer to the gardens of Jannah.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How can one safeguard crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لاَ تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
textEnglish: A man said to the Prophet: “Advise me.” He said: “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he replied: “Do not become angry.”
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6116 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Mastery over impulsive anger preserves wisdom, protects relationships, and prevents regret.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What essential principle transforms our approach to crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow an evil deed with a good one and it will erase it; and treat people with beautiful character.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1987 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Live with God-consciousness in private and public, rapidly correct missteps, and be gracious to all.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: Why is genuine devotion in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
textEnglish: Every one of you is a shepherd and guardian, and every one of you will be questioned concerning his flock.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 893, Sahih Muslim 1829 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Leadership is a sacred trust and responsibility of service, not privilege or authority.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does the heart find tranquility through crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
textEnglish: Verily, Allah loves that whenever any of you undertakes a work, he executes it with mastery and excellence (Itqan).
reference: Shu’ab al-Iman (Al-Bayhaqi 4929, Hasan) · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Excellence in profession, study, and daily duty is an act of devotion loved by the Creator.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What common pitfall did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ warn about in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
textEnglish: Modesty and conscience (Haya) bring nothing except goodness.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6117, Sahih Muslim 37 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Haya is a spiritual shield that restrains the soul from vulgarity and prompts noble conduct.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does moral beauty manifest through crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ كَفَلَ يَتِيمًا لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ فَأَنَا وَهُوَ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
textEnglish: The one who cares for an orphan and myself will be together in Paradise like these two fingers (joining his index and middle finger).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5304, Sahih Muslim 2983 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Caring for vulnerable orphans guarantees the closest companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest Jannah.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What eternal reward is promised for cultivating crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
textEnglish: Charity never decreases wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who forgives except in honor and elevation.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Generosity and forgiveness never degrade a person; they invoke divine barakah and nobility.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How can parents and mentors inspire crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
textEnglish: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him facing you in every need.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2516 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Honor Allah’s commands in times of ease, and He will deliver and comfort you in times of adversity.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What guidance did the Prophet ﷺ emphasize regarding consistency in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
textEnglish: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance (Tawakkul), He would provide for you just as He provides for birds: they depart hungry at dawn and return full at dusk.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2344, Sunan Ibn Majah 4164 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Combine practical effort with tranquil reliance upon the Ultimate Provider.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does divine mercy embrace those who strive in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلاَمٍ
textEnglish: Spread peace (Salam), feed the hungry, maintain kinship ties, and pray during the night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in complete peace.
reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2485, Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: The four golden keys to peaceful entry into Jannah unite communal kindness and private devotion.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: In times of difficulty, how does crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الصَّدَقَةُ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ السَّائِلِ
textEnglish: Charity falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful before it falls into the hand of the needy person.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, Sahih Muslim 1014 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Give charity with profound reverence; you are offering a direct transaction with your Lord.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What reflection on the Hereafter is awakened by crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
textEnglish: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is goodness in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reference: Sahih Muslim 2664 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Cultivate mental, moral, physical, and spiritual strength while maintaining humble reliance on Allah.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does understanding crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
textEnglish: Whoever delights in having his provision expanded and his lifespan blessed and extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5986, Sahih Muslim 2557 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Kindness to relatives and family reconciliation draws barakah into time and livelihood.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What divine wisdom did the Prophet ﷺ reveal regarding crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
textEnglish: When a human being dies, all his deeds cease except for three: recurring charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge left behind, or a righteous child who prays for him.
reference: Sahih Muslim 1631 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Invest your life in legacies that continue to shine and generate divine rewards after your earthly departure.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: How does consistent practice of crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
textEnglish: Actions are judged by motives and intentions, and every person will have only that which they intended.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1, Sahih Muslim 1907 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Purify your heart before every deed; a sincere intention transforms simple daily acts into perpetual worship.

subTopicTitle: Crying from the Fear of Allah
question: What spiritual remedy does crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?
textArabic: الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
textEnglish: Faith is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine destiny—both its prosperity and adversity.
reference: Sahih Muslim 8 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Conviction in Allah’s wisdom gives the believer unwavering calm during life’s unpredictable changes.

textEnglish: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3559, Sahih Muslim 2321 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah

question: In what way does excellence in crying from the fear of allah and how does it elevate a believer’s character and relationship with Allah?

reference: Sahih Muslim 223 · Chapter 175: Crying from the Fear of Allah
keyLesson: Inner and outer purification are intertwined; heartfelt gratitude tilts the eternal scale in your favor.
